title: Davis hired by CIA as WINPAC branch chief scientist

tellings.quote: I actually got hired by the CIA to be the branch chief science K scientist of winpack back in late 2003

plain: In late 2003, the CIA, America's foreign spy agency, hired a scientist named Eric W. Davis to be branch chief scientist of WINPAC, its center for weapons intelligence and arms control. Davis says this about himself as part of his own career. It matters because it would place him inside the intelligence world, the same world he speaks about when he discusses UFOs.
